purpose: Name the pass-specific saved-return continuations used by shared actor-VM opcodes.

consumers.name: ActorVM_SetStreamTimerAndLoop
consumers.effect: Rewrites the saved return address after installing a loop/timer command.

consumers.name: ActorVM_ClearAnimationOrMovementCursor
consumers.effect: Rewrites the saved return address after clearing the selected VM cursor.

evidence: Exact AnimationVM and MovementVM continuation writes
Exact shared timer/loop and cursor-clear saved-return updates
Distinct continuation addresses at the animation and movement pass tails
conclusion: FF7D9A and FF7D9E are two 32-bit pass-specific actor-VM continuation pointers, not persistent actor data.
